ev_0005.summary: Circle O centered at (274.0,245.6) with radius 236 px (full 360 deg visible), consistent with the supervisor's verified labels. Diameter BA passes through O (B at (70,364), A at (478.7,128)). Segment BC is horizontal at y=364 from B to C (478.7,363.5). Segment AC is vertical at x=479 from A down to C. Line AD runs from A through P (342.1,364, unlabeled intersection with BC) down to D (274.1,481.6). I (376.6,304.3) lies on AD and is joined to O by a solid segment OI. Dashed segments: BD (collinear dashed chain from B to D, slope ~30 deg, confirmed by CV line-style analysis). Dashed BI was described by the supervisor but was not detected by CV (B to I is a different slope from BD; treated as unverified). AC is perpendicular to BC at C, which follows from C lying on the circle with diameter BA (Thales); no right-angle mark was verified by CV, so this is reported as a relation only, not as a drawn mark.

The GES listing was truncated, so no explicit right_angle object was visible; D is also geometrically a right angle (inscribed in semicircle) but was not marked since it is not evidenced in the visible GES. Point P is placed in coordinates but not drawn or labelled.
